texts.text: Fire Dept: elevator entrapment at One Park Plaza, 3250 Wilshire. 2 people trapped in stalled elevator, floor 3, car unknown. Please meet fire crew with elevator keys + machine room access.

tenant_flags.risk: High occupancy on the incident floor
tenant_flags.why: The tenant data lists 324 employees on floor 3, the same floor as the stalled elevator. Expect a crowded elevator lobby and heavy demand for the other elevators. Plan for crowd control and keep the stairs clear.

tenant_flags.risk: Possible vulnerable occupants, such as child patients or people with limited mobility
tenant_flags.why: This is inferred from the name only. The industry is listed as Unknown and there is no description, so these floors could just be administrative offices. Check on arrival whether patients are seen here. If they are, people may need help getting around while elevators are out, and the trapped occupants could need medical care.

tenant_flags.risk: Possible medical gases or biohazards; same tenant also on floor 5
tenant_flags.why: This is inferred from the name only. Nothing in the data shows clinical work or hazardous materials on floors 5 and 6. Ask building staff about any medical oxygen or lab materials before relying on the hospital's floors.
